error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If x - 6 = 0 gives x = -6, the issue is the inverse-operation step in a linear equation. This is a building block for solving factorised quadratics.

hint_ladder.title: Solve meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: Solving x - 6 = 0 means finding the value of x that makes the equation true.

hint_ladder.title: Inverse operation
hint_ladder.prompt: Undo subtracting 6 by adding 6 to both sides.

hint_ladder.title: Sign reversal
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is moving 6 across and flipping the sign the other way. Check by substituting your x back in.

hint_ladder.title: Linear-zero routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For x - a = 0, add a to both sides; for x + a = 0, subtract a. Apply the matching case here; do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on undoing the subtraction with the correct inverse operation and checking the resulting x value.
